clue.text: Rambling with company in a natural setting

indicators.note: the clue says the company sits in a natural setting, so one word goes inside another

parts.note: something inherent is natural, built in from the start

explanation.surface: Someone describes a business outing held out in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rambling' suggests a country walk, which the natural setting supports, but it is the definition: incoherent talk rambles.
explanation.definitionFit: Rambling talk is disjointed and hard to follow, lacking logical connection.

clue.text: Press for an element essential to life

definitions.meaning: to smooth clothes with a heated appliance
the metallic element Fe, needed in blood

explanation.surface: A newspaper campaign about a vital chemical element.
explanation.definitionFit: To press clothes is to smooth them flat with a hot appliance, and the metal Fe is a chemical element the body cannot do without.

clue.text: Cool, one has gathered

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm while picking things up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one has' is a link phrase: someone who has gathered things has them in one heap.
explanation.definitionFit: A composed person is calm and unflustered; things brought together in one pile have been amassed.

clue.text: Animal finds fruit on river

parts.note: a hip is the fruit of the rose
the Po is the major river of northern Italy

explanation.surface: Some creature comes across fruit floating on a river.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts the fruit above the river, so HIP comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: The river horse of Africa is a large mammal, a beast by any measure.

clue.text: The remainder live around the university

indicators.note: around tells us the word for live wraps itself about the university letter

parts.note: to reside somewhere is to live there
U is the usual abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: Those left over make their homes near the campus.
explanation.definitionFit: What is left after the rest is removed is the leftover portion.

clue.text: Drivers pass through it for a change

definitions.text: Drivers pass through it for a change

parts.words: Drivers pass through it for a change
parts.note: a motorist moving the gear lever between gears goes through the position where no gear is engaged

explanation.surface: Motorists go somewhere just for variety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a change' sounds like 'for variety', but it is a gear change.
explanation.definitionFit: The lever position with no gear engaged sits between the gears, so every shift passes it.

clue.text: "The church" incomplete as address for a priest

indicators.note: incomplete says the church word lacks its final letter

parts.note: an abbey is a church of a monastery

explanation.surface: A clergyman is greeted simply as 'the church', words cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: In French usage a priest or cleric is addressed by this title, as English speakers say Father.

clue.text: Players take their time watching it

definitions.text: Players take their time watching it

parts.words: Players take their time watching it
parts.note: orchestral players follow the conductor's stick to keep time

explanation.surface: Sportspeople dawdle as they watch something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take their time' looks like dawdling; it means following the beat.
explanation.definitionFit: A conductor beats time with a short stick, and the players watch it for the tempo.

clue.text: Cutting out inner hesitation with practice

definitions.note: a noun here; the answer works as a verbal noun meaning drill

indicators.note: inner says the hesitation goes inside the word for cutting out

parts.note: excising means cutting out, as in surgery
ER is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Surgical removal of one's doubts through rehearsal.
explanation.definitionFit: Training or drilling the body or a skill is the act of putting it to use regularly.

clue.text: He struggled to maintain faith in the past

definitions.text: He struggled to maintain faith in the past

parts.words: He struggled to maintain faith in the past
parts.note: a medieval knight fought holy wars to defend Christianity

explanation.surface: A man once battled to keep believing.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests personal doubt; the struggle was a medieval holy war.
explanation.definitionFit: Medieval Christian knights fought wars in the Holy Land in the name of their religion.

clue.text: A deck or dock

parts.note: taken as written
to dock a tail is to lop it, cut it short

explanation.surface: A ship's deck or a harbour dock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dock' pretends to be a quay; here it is a verb, to cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest deck of a sailing ship is called by this name.

clue.text: Best route perhaps for a soprano in a minor role

definitions.text: a soprano in a minor role

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the best route is only one possible arrangement of these letters

explanation.surface: Advice on the best way for a singer to get a small part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' signals rearranging BEST ROUTE.
explanation.definitionFit: In opera a pert maidservant part is often sung by a light soprano voice.

clue.text: He tries an instrument

definitions.meaning: a part-time judge who hears court cases
a wooden woodwind pipe played by schoolchildren

explanation.surface: A man has a go at playing music.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a Recorder is a barrister sitting as a part-time judge, so he tries cases.
explanation.definitionFit: A part-time judge in English courts bears this title, and it is also a simple wooden flute.

clue.text: Describing a boom in the travel industry

definitions.text: Describing a boom in the travel industry

parts.words: Describing a boom in the travel industry
parts.note: a boom is the bang an aircraft makes breaking the sound barrier, not a business surge

explanation.surface: Commentary on a surge in tourism business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boom' reads as an economic upturn; it is the bang of supersonic flight.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective for sound waves qualifies the bang a jet makes passing the sound barrier.

clue.text: One sportsman to be all for reorganisation

indicators.note: reorganisation calls for the letters of the preceding words to be put in a new order

explanation.surface: A player declares he backs a club shake-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reorganisation' rearranges TO BE ALL FOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A soccer or rugby player is an athlete in a team sport.

clue.text: One must do it to survive

definitions.text: One must do it to survive

parts.words: One must do it to survive
parts.note: to survive someone is to stay alive longer than they do

explanation.surface: A grim maxim about what it takes to stay alive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'survive' seems to mean stay alive at all; here it means remain alive after another dies.
explanation.definitionFit: Surviving a person means living longer than them.

clue.text: Audio centre?

parts.note: the inmost part of the organ of hearing, where sound is processed

explanation.surface: A hi-fi store or sound studio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Audio centre' sounds like a shop selling stereos; it is the deep part of the hearing organ.
explanation.definitionFit: The innermost section of the hearing organ holds the cochlea, the core of the sense.

clue.text: Many snakes are associated with them

definitions.text: Many snakes are associated with them

parts.words: Many snakes are associated with them
parts.note: in the board game, snakes slide you down while climbing aids take you up

explanation.surface: A note about where serpents gather.
explanation.walkthrough: Snakes and Ladders is a children's board game of chance played on a grid of squares.
explanation.definitionFit: The board game pairs serpents with climbing steps.

clue.text: Such duties come with one's position in society

definitions.text: Such duties come with one's position in society

parts.words: Such duties come with one's position in society
parts.note: Latin for 'by virtue of office': roles held automatically because of a post

explanation.surface: A remark about the obligations of rank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'position in society' suggests social standing; it means an official post.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin term means held by virtue of an office, so duties attached to a post.

clue.text: News of current interest?

parts.note: current is taken as a flow of the sea, so news reads as word of the tides

explanation.surface: Topical news stories.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' looks like topical, but it is a sea current; the answer contains TIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for news or messages, it also suggests reports about the tide.

clue.text: Notices faulty part

indicators.note: faulty suggests the notices are wrongly put together, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone spots a defective component.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faulty' rearranges NOTICES; 'Notices' looks like a verb but is the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A division or segment of something is one portion of it.

clue.text: Drawing an unloaded vehicle

parts.note: a cart is a simple vehicle
with nothing on: O (nothing) followed by ON

explanation.surface: A horse is pulling an empty wagon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drawing' looks like pulling the vehicle; it is the definition. An unloaded cart has O (nothing) ON it.
explanation.definitionFit: A humorous sketch or comic strip picture is a kind of illustration.

clue.text: Top-quality work produced by pupils in college, initially

parts.note: a class is a group of pupils

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letters of the two words just before it

explanation.surface: Excellent coursework by students at a college.
explanation.definitionFit: A book or film of lasting excellence is held up as a model of its kind.

clue.text: Tears shed for daisy

indicators.note: shed suggests the tears are broken up and scattered, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Someone cries over a flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed' rearranges TEARS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Michaelmas daisy is one of many plants of this star-shaped flower genus.

clue.text: High place for a bird to live in

indicators.note: in places the word for living inside the bird's name

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
to be is to exist or live

explanation.surface: A lofty spot where a bird might make its home.
explanation.definitionFit: The Himalayan region is known as the roof of the world for its great altitude.

clue.text: Grade form I extremely firmly

parts.note: a form is a school class

indicators.note: extremely takes the letters at the extreme ends of the word firmly

explanation.surface: A teacher marks one class with great rigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'form' is a British school word for a year group or class.
explanation.definitionFit: To grade things is to sort them into categories or ranks.

clue.text: A student on board having a dance

indicators.note: on board means aboard a ship, so the letters go inside the ship's abbreviation

parts.note: a ship's deck is boarded; SS stands for steamship
L is for learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A learner on a ship takes part in a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' puts A and L inside SS (steamship), giving SALS, and the final 'a' completes it.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively Latin American dance, set to music of the same name.

clue.text: Soundly thrash, using a crop

indicators.note: Soundly signals that the word for thrash is heard rather than seen

parts.note: to beat someone is to thrash them

explanation.surface: Advice to give someone a hiding with a riding crop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crop' looks like a riding whip, but it is a farm crop.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar or red root vegetables are grown in fields as a farm product.

clue.text: Two signs merge to show where books may be obtained

indicators.note: merge says the two signs overlap, sharing one letter where they join

parts.note: Libra is a sign of the zodiac
Aries is another zodiac sign

explanation.surface: Astrology suggests where to borrow reading matter.
explanation.walkthrough: LIBRA and ARIES share the A where they meet, so one A is dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Public lending rooms keep collections of volumes for readers to borrow.

clue.text: Cruel fluctuation in money

indicators.note: fluctuation suggests unsteady change, so the letters of cruel are shifted about

explanation.surface: Harsh swings in the value of cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fluctuation' rearranges CRUEL.
explanation.definitionFit: Filthy lucre is a scornful term for cash or profit.

clue.text: Speed charge

explanation.surface: A fee for going fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Pace is measured as so much per hour, and a price per unit is a tariff.

clue.text: One blow to end a fight in pure slapstick

parts.note: a knock is a blow
A means one
a bout is a boxing match

explanation.surface: A single punch ends a brawl in farce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to end a fight' reads as stopping it; BOUT simply goes at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Boisterous, rough-and-tumble comedy is described with this adjective.
